## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 95 captures during February 2021. This activity provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month. The capture total is reported as provided, without adjustment or estimation.

## Image quality

Of the 95 captures, 2 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.1 per cent. The ungradable findings are reported separately from the overall capture activity so that the quality outcome can be considered alongside the grading results. The figures indicate the number of captures that could not be used for grading and the corresponding proportion of all captures.

## Grading

Grading identified 13 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This is the reported midpoint for the time between the image being captured and the grading outcome being recorded. The grading figures should be read together with the image-quality results: 2 captures were ungradable, while 13 results were classified as referable. All figures relate to East City Eye Clinic and February 2021.
